title: Akari Pulse phone sleep summary
description: One vivo sleep day read from content://com.vivo.health.provider/sleep. vivo attributes a sleep record to the local calendar day of its wake-up time with a zero day offset, so source_day is the provider's own DATE column and is never recomputed downstream. Only an observed sleep day is transmitted: a permission, provider, or parse failure has no calendar day to attach to and is reported through the diagnostic_vivo_private_health event instead.

source_day.description: Provider DATE column: the local calendar day the wake-up time falls in.

source_timezone.description: Device timezone at read time. The provider does not expose the timezone the record was written in.

source_day_start.description: Provider TIMESTAMP column: local midnight of source_day, Unix epoch milliseconds.

sleep_start.description: Provider ENTER_TIME: fell asleep, Unix epoch milliseconds.

sleep_end.description: Provider EXIT_TIME: woke up, Unix epoch milliseconds.

sampled_at.description: When the bridge read the provider. Drives the newer-wins rule for the same source_day.

recorder_generation.description: Provider WATCH_GENERATION: -1 phone detection, 1/2/3 watch generation.

awake_episode_count.description: Derived: awake intervals lying strictly inside the sleep span, matching the vivo Health wake-up count.

stages.description: Stage intervals exactly as the provider returned them. A stage key is absent when the provider returned no list for it; an absent stage is never rendered as a zero-length stage.
